_comment: Spoken form in, written form expected out. Actual is what Apple SpeechTranscriber produced on 2026-09-08 -- measured, not guessed. Every mismatch is a dictionary case.

segments.spoken: I ran terra grunt against the azure landing zone, then terra form applied the V net and the H C L was valid.
segments.actual: I ran Terra Grunt against the azure landing zone, then Terraform applied the V net and the HCL was valid.
segments.expected: I ran Terragrunt against the Azure landing zone, then Terraform applied the VNet and the HCL was valid.

segments.spoken: We deployed to A W S as well, and kube control showed the pods running.
segments.actual: We deployed to AWS as well, and cube control showed the pods running.
segments.expected: We deployed to AWS as well, and kubectl showed the pods running.
